# UnsupportedSchemaVersionException

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Formats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public class UnsupportedSchemaVersionException : NotSupportedException
```

A manifest declares a schema this build cannot read. Raised instead of letting an unknown format deserialize into whatever happens to fit. (Not an `InvalidDataException` only because that type is sealed — the archive is well-formed, just too new to support.)

## Methods

### Require&lt;T&gt;(T) { #m-require-1-0 }

```csharp
public static void Require<T>(T manifest) where T : ISchemaVersioned;
```

Accepts any schema this build understands — [`Schema.Oldest`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Core.Model.Schema.md#f-oldest) through [`Schema.Current`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Core.Model.Schema.md#f-current) — and rejects anything outside that range, older or newer alike. This used to demand EXACT equality with [`Schema.Current`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Core.Model.Schema.md#f-current), which made the format unevolvable: bumping Current by one would have made every .cbk, .rcp and .igt already written unreadable, including the tests/fixtures archives that exist to catch precisely that. A version gate whose only safe value is the one it already has is not a gate. Reading an older-but-still-supported version is sound because of a contract this project keeps deliberately: \*\*every field added after the floor schema is optional and carries a default that means "absent"\*\*. A floor-schema archive is therefore a valid vN archive with those fields unset. A change that cannot honour that — a renamed field, a changed meaning, a new REQUIRED field — is a breaking change, and needs a real migration here rather than a bump. Newer is still refused outright: a future field this build does not know about could change what the archive means, and silently ignoring it would produce confidently wrong output. Rise, 2026-09-25: [`Schema.Oldest`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Core.Model.Schema.md#f-oldest) moved from 1 to 2 — v1 is dropped by the author's decision, no archives kept (see CLAUDE.md) — so a schemaVersion below the floor is now refused too, by the same exception type and the same "name it, don't misparse it" reason as a too-new one, distinguished from a version below 1 (which was never a schema at all).

**Parameters**

- `manifest` (`T`) - The manifest whose [`ISchemaVersioned.SchemaVersion`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Core.Model.ISchemaVersioned.md#p-schemaversion) to check.

**Type parameters**

- `T` - The manifest type; its name (minus "Manifest") appears in the message.

**Exceptions**

- [`UnsupportedSchemaVersionException`](Nfty.Core.Formats.UnsupportedSchemaVersionException.md) - The version is newer than [`Schema.Current`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Core.Model.Schema.md#f-current), older than [`Schema.Oldest`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Core.Model.Schema.md#f-oldest), or not a schema at all.
